lines.en: label futabanew3:
I knock on Futaba’s door and the video game breaks.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，然后这款电子游戏就崩坏了。

lines.en: scene insertredux3
scene futabanewtwo24
scene insertredux4
scene anotherfutabaevent1

The theme for a girl I have yet to meet slips down the holes inside of my head called “ears” and works its way throughout my body, getting caught on a variety of hairs and other things you typically find in bodies.
lines.zh: 一个我尚未谋面的女孩的主题曲，从我脑袋上那两个叫作「耳朵」的洞里滑进去，一路游走遍我全身，卡在各种毛发、以及你通常能在身体里找到的其他东西上。

lines.en: I knock again because Futaba is glitched and I must brute force Lessons in Love back into doing what I want it to do.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次，因为 Futaba 卡 bug 了，我必须用蛮力把《Lessons in Love》掰回我想要它做的事上。

lines.en: No matter how many times I knock, though, she remains tucked in the corner behind a circular shadow, staring at the wall and waiting for its paper to wrap around her.
lines.zh: 但不管我敲多少次，她都缩在角落里一团圆形阴影后面，盯着墙壁，等着墙纸把自己包裹起来。

lines.en: I long to wrap myself around her the way she wishes the paper would but, unfortunately, that will not be an option I have until later.
lines.zh: 我渴望像她希望墙纸那样，把自己缠绕在她身上——但遗憾的是，那要等到之后才会成为我的选项。

lines.en: A GIFT RAINS DOWN UPON YOU
lines.zh: 一份礼物如雨般降临于你

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent2
YOU HAVE RECEIVED AN [[incomplete Futaba]
lines.zh: 你获得了一个 [[未完成的 Futaba]

lines.en: : Let’s party!
lines.zh: : 来派对吧！

lines.en: : I don’t want to party. I am here to check on your writing assignment and learn more about why you avoid mirrors.
lines.zh: : 我不想开派对。我是来查看你的写作作业的，还想多了解一点你为什么躲着镜子。

lines.en: : Leeeeeet’s party!
lines.zh: : 来——派对嘛！

lines.en: : Futaba, stop it. And tell your T-posing clone to go away too.
lines.zh: : Futaba，别闹了。还有，让你那个摆着 T 字姿势的复制人也一边去。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent3
: {b}Let’s party!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}来派对吧！{/b}

lines.en: : Ugh...
Welp, looks like it’s going to be another hectic night for me.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来今晚又是一个鸡飞狗跳的夜晚。

lines.en: And here I was thinking Futaba was exempt from duplicating or getting caught in glitches.
lines.zh: 我本来还以为 Futaba 不会复制自己，也不会被卡进 bug 里。

lines.en: : Let’s-
: Shut the fuck up for a second. I don’t want to party and I’m trying to make the game go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 给老子闭嘴一秒钟。我不想开派对，我正在努力让游戏恢复正常。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent4
: Party now! Party now! Party now!
lines.zh: : 现在就派对！现在就派对！现在就派对！

lines.en: I begrudgingly remove a collapsible party hat from my back pocket and stick it on top of my head, hoping that its juices quickly dissolve into my skull because I really don’t have time for this right now.
lines.zh: 我不情不愿地从后裤袋里掏出一顶可折叠的派对帽扣在头上，希望它的汁液能快点溶进我的头骨里，因为我眼下真的没时间折腾这个。

lines.en: : Your story-
lines.zh: : 你的故事——

lines.en: : YOU WORRY TOO MUCH ABOUT THE STORY.
lines.zh: : 你在故事上操的心太多了。

lines.en: : WE NEED TO HAVE FUN SOMETIMES TOO, SENSEI!
lines.zh: : 我们偶尔也需要找点乐子啊，SENSEI！

lines.en: : ISN’T THE FUN OVERDUE, SENSEI?!
lines.zh: : 这份乐子不是早就该补上了吗，SENSEI？！

lines.en: : DON’T YOU WANT TO TOUCH MY FAT FUCKING TITS, SENSEI?
lines.zh: : 你不想摸摸我这对大得要命的奶子吗，SENSEI？

lines.en: : Futaba, please. Not at the party.
lines.zh: : Futaba，拜托。别在派对上。

lines.en: : DO IT. DO IT, YOU FUCKING WORM.
lines.zh: : 摸啊。快摸啊，你这个该死的蛆虫。

lines.en: : I’M NOT SCARED. I’M READY.
lines.zh: : 我不怕。我准备好了。

lines.en: : MY AFFINITY FOR YOU GROWS LIKE A REDWOOD AND YET YOU SIT IDLY BY AND WATCH.
lines.zh: : 我对你的爱意像红杉一样疯长，你却坐视不理、袖手旁观。

lines.en: : YOU FAVOR ME.
lines.zh: : 你偏爱我。

lines.en: : YOU FAVOR ME WHEN YOU KNOW I WILL DO ANYTHING TO MAKE YOU LIKE ME.
lines.zh: : 你明明知道我为了让你喜欢我什么都肯做，却还是偏爱我。

lines.en: : PEEL AWAY THE THIN LAYERS OF FABRIC THAT COVER THE PARTS OF ME I HAVE SAVED FOR YOU.
lines.zh: : 把我身上那些为你留着的地方，那几层薄薄的布料，全都剥开。

lines.en: : PLUCK MY PETALS.
lines.zh: : 摘下我的花瓣。

lines.en: My pants suddenly tighten but I’m worried about making any moves due to the extra Futaba still hanging out in the corner of the room, even if her head is now obscured by a fun party banner.
lines.zh: 我的裤子突然绷紧了，可我不敢轻举妄动，因为房间里还赖着多出来的那个 Futaba——尽管她的脑袋现在被一条有趣的派对横幅挡住了。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent5
When I blink, it all disappears and I realize that no time has passed at all.
lines.zh: 我一眨眼，这一切全都消失了，我这才意识到，时间根本一点都没过去。

lines.en: I should probably knock on Futaba’s door because that is why I am here.
lines.zh: 我大概该敲敲 Futaba 的门了，因为我来这儿就是为了这个。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent6
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Is...everything okay? I thought I heard someone outside of the door, but...I figured it was just Miku trying to mess with me again.
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗？我好像听到门外有人，可是……我以为又是 Miku 在捉弄我。

lines.en: : Were you...about to knock? Or are you just passing by?
lines.zh: : 你是……正要敲门吗？还是只是路过？

lines.en: : This isn’t really a place I can just “pass by.” And besides, I {i}did{/i} knock. A bunch of times, actually.
lines.zh: : 这儿可不是我能「顺路路过」的地方。再说了，我{i}确实{/i}敲了门。事实上还敲了好多下。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent7
: You did? I’m so sorry then...I must not have heard.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那真是太抱歉了……我一定是没听见。

lines.en: : {s}DON’T LET IT HAPPEN AGAIN, YOU FUCKING CUNT{/s} It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : {s}别再有下次了，你这个臭婊子{/s}没关系的。别放在心上。

lines.en: : Hey, are you doing anything right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你现在有事吗？

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent6
: Right now? No...I was about to go take a shower, but...I suppose I can wait until you’re gone.
lines.zh: : 现在？没有……我刚打算去洗澡，不过……我想等你走了再去也行。

lines.en: : Great. Do you want to go somewhere darker with me?
lines.zh: : 很好。要不要跟我一起去暗一点的地方？

lines.en: : Umm...darker?
lines.zh: : 呃……暗一点？

lines.en: : Somewhere far away.
lines.zh: : 某个很远的地方。

lines.en: : I can’t be here right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在没法待在这儿。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent8
: Sensei...if you want to talk about something, I-
lines.zh: : Sensei……如果你想聊聊什么的话，我——

lines.en: : Are you coming or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？

lines.en: Futaba thinks long and hard about whether or not she wants to put her faith into a man who would trade it all away for a mouth to cum inside of.
lines.zh: Futaba 思来想去，考虑要不要把自己的信任交给一个会为了一张能射进去的嘴而把它全部出卖的男人。

lines.en: In several seconds, she will make the wrong decision.
lines.zh: 几秒钟之后，她会做出那个错误的决定。

lines.en: And the two of us will embark on a hot, sweaty journey across this make-believe world together.
lines.zh: 而我们两个将一起踏上一段穿越这个虚构世界的、又热又汗津津的旅程。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent9
: We can go wherever you’d like...
lines.zh: : 你想去哪儿我们就去哪儿……

lines.en: scene black
That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: We can go wherever I’d like.
lines.zh: 我想去哪儿就能去哪儿。

lines.en: None of this is real.
lines.zh: 这一切都不是真的。

lines.en: Anything that I have convinced myself I’ve felt as of late is nothing short of cowardice.
lines.zh: 最近那些我说服自己去相信的感受，统统不过是怯懦罢了。

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama is a naive teenage girl who is doing her best to appeal to me in ways deeper than her skin, but her skin alone is what I want.
lines.zh: Futaba Fukuyama 是个天真的少女，她拼命想用比皮囊更深的层次来吸引我，可我想要的偏偏只有她的皮囊。

lines.en: I want the scent of lavender to stain my bedsheets.
lines.zh: 我想让薰衣草的香气染上我的床单。

lines.en: I want my skin underneath her fingernails.
lines.zh: 我想让我的皮肤留在她的指甲缝里。

lines.en: I want her.
lines.zh: 我想要她。

lines.en: I want her I want her I want her I want her.
lines.zh: 我想要她我想要她我想要她我想要她。

lines.en: And that is exactly why I can’t be here right now.
lines.zh: 而这也正是我现在不能待在这儿的原因。

lines.en: Because if the two of us remained here, I would take her with the minimal amount of force I am sure it would require.
lines.zh: 因为如果我们两个继续留在这儿，我会用我确信所需的最少的力气把她占有。

lines.en: I lead her out into the night in an attempt to mask my shadow with something darker.
lines.zh: 我领着她走进夜色，试图用更浓的黑暗来遮住自己的影子。

lines.en: She follows suit, blushing and bouncing.
lines.zh: 她跟着我，脸颊泛红，步子一颠一颠的。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent10
We end up somewhere not at all familiar to me.
lines.zh: 我们最后走到了一个我完全不熟悉的地方。

lines.en: I don’t know how long it took the two of us to get here or the space between where we stand right now and where Futaba will rest her head tonight...
lines.zh: 我不知道我们俩走了多久才到这儿，也不知道我们此刻站的位置，和今晚 Futaba 将枕着头入睡的地方之间隔着多远……

lines.en: But I’m not too worried.
lines.zh: 但我不太担心。

lines.en: Because the uncertainties inside of me have managed to fade like the dull colors of the traffic lights around us, incessantly cycling between “go” and “stop” and not offering anything in between.
lines.zh: 因为我内心的那些不确定，已经像周围交通灯那黯淡的颜色一样淡去了——它们不停地在「行」和「停」之间循环，从不提供任何中间状态。

lines.en: It reminds me a little of myself, but not in a good way.
lines.zh: 这让我有点想到自己，但不是什么好的方面。

lines.en: Lately, I have found myself getting so caught up in the depths of my mind that, sometimes, I’m shocked I’m able to crawl out at all.
lines.zh: 最近，我发现自己越来越深地陷进脑海的深处，有时候我都很惊讶自己居然还能爬出来。

lines.en: I never know when it’s happening.
lines.zh: 我从来不知道它正在发生。

lines.en: In fact, a lot of the time, I don’t even know when it’s over.
lines.zh: 事实上，很多时候，我甚至不知道它什么时候结束的。

lines.en: But when everything about this life is still a blur to me, even now, I can’t help but come unglued.
lines.zh: 但当关于这种生活的一切对我来说依然是一片模糊时——即便到了现在——我还是忍不住会崩溃。

lines.en: What is real?
lines.zh: 什么是真的？

lines.en: What is not?
lines.zh: 什么不是？

lines.en: And what substance is being used to keep me grounded? Because it is very clearly not working if I’ve managed to make even Futaba uncomfortable tonight.
lines.zh: 又是靠什么物质把我固定在大地上？因为它显然没起作用——不然我今晚也不至于连 Futaba 都弄得不舒服。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent11
: Can I ask you something, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 我能问你一件事吗，Futaba？

lines.en: : Of course. Though...it’s a little worrying to have you {i}ask{/i} to ask me rather than just ask me outright.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过……你先{i}问{/i}「能不能问」而不是直接问出来，这让人有点担心。

lines.en: : Are you scared of me?
lines.zh: : 你怕我吗？

lines.en: : Scared?
: This isn’t normal...Coming to your room in the middle of the night and standing outside your door...Dragging you with me to some part of town I’ve never even seen before...
lines.zh: : 这不正常……半夜三更跑到你房间来，站在你门外……把你拽到一个我连见都没见过的城区……

lines.en: : And all for nothing, too.
lines.zh: : 而且到头来什么都没做成。

lines.en: : It’s not nothing, Sensei. You didn’t want to be in the dorms, right?
lines.zh: : 那可不是什么都没做成，Sensei。你只是不想待在宿舍里，对吧？

lines.en: : And I’m assuming...you didn’t want to be at home either.
lines.zh: : 我猜……你也不想待在家里。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m just the lucky one who managed to open her door and find you first tonight, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己是不是只是今晚运气好，开了门就先撞见了你，不过……

lines.en: : I’m not scared of you.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你。

lines.en: : Well, you should be.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可你应该怕。

lines.en: : Why do you say that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么说？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I just think that you’re supposed to be scared of me.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你本该怕我。

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, I don’t think that’s a very compelling reason. So I think I’ll just remain unafraid, if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不觉得这是个很有说服力的理由。所以我想我还是继续不怕好了，如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : What will it take to make you scared of me?
lines.zh: : 要怎样你才会怕我？

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound like you {i}want{/i} me to be scared of you.
lines.zh: : 你听起来开始像是{i}希望{/i}我怕你了。

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得是这样。

lines.en: : I just don’t understand why you...or anyone else for the matter, is just {i}okay{/i} with me doing the things I do when they’re so clearly wrong.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白，为什么你……或者说其他任何人，都能对我做的那些明摆着是错的事{i}无动于衷{/i}。

lines.en: : I think...the answer to that might be a little more boring than you expect, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……这个答案可能比你预想的要无聊一点，Sensei。

lines.en: : We simply...don’t think the things you do are wrong.
lines.zh: : 我们只是……不觉得你做的事是错的。

lines.en: : Then you’re all just as lost as I am.
lines.zh: : 那你们和我一样迷失。

lines.en: : Maybe we are...
lines.zh: : 也许是吧……

lines.en: : But we trust and respect our guide.
lines.zh: : 但我们信任并尊敬我们的向导。

lines.en: : And...I may not be able to speak for anyone else...but I don’t think that part of me will ever change.
lines.zh: : 而且……我也许没法代表其他人……但我觉得，我的这一部分永远不会改变。

lines.en: : I might not be the type of heroine you’d enjoy to read about in a story, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我大概不是你会在故事里喜欢读到的那种女主角，Sensei……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: : I think I make a pretty good supporting character.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我当个配角还算不错。

lines.en: : And I’ll support you in any way you want...because {i}that’s{/i} how much I trust you.
lines.zh: : 而且我会用任何你想要的方式支持你……因为我是{i}这么{/i}信任你。

lines.en: : You’re making a mistake.
lines.zh: : 你正在犯一个错误。

lines.en: : Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : We’ll see about that...
lines.zh: : 那我们就等着瞧吧……

lines.en: scene black
We make our way up the incline and disappear down an alleyway because even the light of the moon is too bright for me to properly hide right now.
lines.zh: 我们沿着坡道往上走，然后消失在一条小巷里——因为此刻连月光都太亮了，让我没法好好藏起来。

lines.en: I don’t understand Futaba at all. I don’t understand why she’s okay with me or why she’d even go as far as calling me her {i}guide{/i} when I am merely one dark passage away from stealing something precious to her.
lines.zh: 我完全不理解 Futaba。我不理解她为什么能接受我，也不理解她为什么甚至会叫我{i}「向导」{/i}——而我离偷走她珍贵的东西，只差一条黑暗的通道。

lines.en: There are no cars this late at night. None near us at least.
lines.zh: 这么晚已经没有车了。至少我们附近一辆都没有。

lines.en: Everything is perfectly silent apart from Futaba’s boots making contact with the ground.
lines.zh: 一切都静得彻底，只有 Futaba 的靴子踩在地上的声音。

lines.en: It gets colder as we get higher.
lines.zh: 越往上走越冷。

lines.en: I haven’t felt a chill like this in a long time.
lines.zh: 我已经很久没有感受过这样的寒意了。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent12
: Huh...I think we’re actually getting kind of close to one of the edges of Kumon-mi...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得我们其实已经快到 Kumon-mi 的某个边缘了……

lines.en: : We’re not in some sort of...restricted area or something, are we?
lines.zh: : 我们该不会闯进了什么……管制区域之类的吧？

lines.en: : Have you never seen the barrier up close before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你以前没近距离看过那道屏障吗？

lines.en: : I went with a friend of mine once. We wrote our given names on the wall just last year...right before I started high school.
lines.zh: : 我以前和一个朋友去过一次。就在去年，我们在墙上写下了各自的名字……就在我上高中之前。

lines.en: : Is this the same friend I’ve heard you talk about before?
lines.zh: : 是我以前听你说过的那个朋友吗？

lines.en: : It is. And it’s probably safe to assume she’s the one I’m talking about whenever I don’t say “Rin,” since those two are basically my only good friends.
lines.zh: : 是的。而且大概可以这么认为：只要我没说「Rin」，那我提到的就是她——因为她们两个基本上就是我仅有的好朋友。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, the part we wrote on is miles away from here. And, honestly, I don’t even know if I’d be able to find it or if...these walls are ever cleaned.
lines.zh: : 可惜，我们写字的那一段离这儿有好几英里远。说实话，我甚至都不知道自己还能不能找到它，也不知道……这些墙到底有没有人清洗。

lines.en: : Should we write our names on the wall as well?
lines.zh: : 那我们也要在墙上写名字吗？

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent13
: Maybe. Come to think of it...I don’t even know your real name.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。这么一想……我连你的真名都不知道。

lines.en: : I’d just write “Sensei” anyway. As far as I’m concerned, that {i}is{/i} my name.
lines.zh: : 反正我也会只写「Sensei」。对我来说，那{i}就是{/i}我的名字。

lines.en: : Do you really want to go? It’s {i}really{/i} big up close. But I guess that’s to be expected since the whole point is to isolate us in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你真的想去吗？近距离看它{i}真的{/i}很大。不过我想这也是意料之中，毕竟它存在的全部意义本来就是把我们隔离起来。

lines.en: : Not to be a downer, but a trip to a giant wall doesn’t sound like much fun. I was just kidding about writing our names down anyway.
lines.zh: : 不是要扫兴，不过跑去看一堵巨大的墙听起来没什么意思。反正我刚才说写名字也是开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent14
: I guess I’m just a little gullible then.
lines.zh: : 那看来我还真有点好骗。

lines.en: : But, um...if we’re {i}not{/i} going to keep going until we reach the end...would you mind if we took a little break soon?
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……如果我们{i}不打算{/i}一直走到尽头……能不能找个地方休息一下？

lines.en: : It goes without saying, but...I’m not really...um...one of the {i}fittest{/i} girls in the class and...we’ve been walking for a while now.
lines.zh: : 这话不说也罢，不过……我其实不太算……呃……班上{i}体力最好{/i}的女生，而且……我们已经走了好一会儿了。

lines.en: : Sure. We’ll stop at the next bench we see and head back home after that.
lines.zh: : 好。我们看到下一张长椅就停下来，之后就回去。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent13
: Are you okay with that? Going home, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那样你没问题吗？我是说，回去的事。

lines.en: : Of course. I’m completely fine.
lines.zh: : 当然。我完全没事。

lines.en: : I just felt like walking tonight...and what better place to walk than some random, dimly lit area near a giant wall?
lines.zh: : 我只是今晚想走走……还有什么地方比一堵巨墙旁边那个随随便便、灯光昏暗的地方更适合散步的呢？

lines.en: : Heheh...right. What better place indeed.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊。确实再好不过了。

lines.en: scene black
Alley after alley, light after light...our journey continues and somehow manages to grow even colder than I had mentioned it being just moments ago.
lines.zh: 一条又一条小巷，一盏又一盏灯……我们的旅程继续着，而且不知怎么的，比我刚才说的还要更冷。

lines.en: I guess that even summer has nights like that.
lines.zh: 我想，即使是夏天也有这样的夜晚。

lines.en: Despite the drop in temperature, I am never once tempted to reach for Futaba’s hand and warm it using my own.
lines.zh: 尽管气温降了下来，我却一次都没有想去握住 Futaba 的手，用自己的手替她取暖。

lines.en: I’m tempted to do plenty of other things of course...and perhaps I even would if it were not for the infectious smile that she’s yet to abandon even once since setting out into the night with me.
lines.zh: 我当然被不少别的事诱惑着……要不是她从跟我踏入夜色起就一次都没收起过那个富有感染力的笑容，我也许真的会动手。

lines.en: Maybe I {i}do{/i} want her to fear me?
lines.zh: 也许我{i}确实{/i}想让她怕我？

lines.en: Maybe the fear is what compels me to act at all?
lines.zh: 也许正是恐惧驱使我采取行动？

lines.en: And maybe, if I can wipe that smile off of her face-
lines.zh: 也许，如果我能把她脸上的笑容抹掉——

lines.en: I can spare her from the agony I am sure she will endure because of me.
lines.zh: 我就能让她免于那份我确信她会因我而承受的痛苦。

lines.en: Maybe not tonight.
lines.zh: 也许不是今晚。

lines.en: Maybe not the next.
lines.zh: 也许不是下一晚。

lines.en: But one day, everything around her will come crashing down.
lines.zh: 但总有一天，她身边的一切都会轰然崩塌。

lines.en: And chances are...when she looks up...I will be towering over her and the remnants of all that she loves.
lines.zh: 而很有可能……当她抬起头时……我会高高矗立在她和她所爱的一切的残骸之上。

lines.en: With a hammer in one hand-
lines.zh: 一只手握着锤子——

lines.en: And the base of my cock in the other.
lines.zh: 另一只手握着我鸡巴的根部。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent15
: Umm...forgive me for asking this, but...have you been intentionally looking away from me all night? Or is that just...happening on accident?
lines.zh: : 呃……请原谅我问这个，不过……你整晚都在故意躲开我的视线吗？还是说……只是碰巧？

lines.en: : I haven’t really been thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 我其实没怎么想过这件事。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : You...
: You can look at me, you know?...
lines.zh: : 你可以看着我的，你知道吗？……

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent16
I turn to look at Futaba.
lines.zh: 我转过头去看 Futaba。

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy5
scene anotherfutabaevent17
But she melts into a puddle of goat’s milk that I can’t help but lap up with my clam’s tongue.
lines.zh: 但她融化成了一滩羊奶，而我忍不住用我那蛤蜊的舌头把它舔干净。

lines.en: : There...don’t you think it’s easier to have a conversation when we’re both looking at each other?
lines.zh: : 这样……你不觉得我们互相看着对方的时候，比较容易聊天吗？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: : Now...is there anything you want to talk to me about, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……你有什么想跟我说的吗，Sensei？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: : Is there...anything you want {i}me{/i} to talk to {i}you{/i} about?
lines.zh: : 有没有……什么{i}你{/i}想让{i}我{/i}跟你说的？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: No no no no no.
lines.zh: 不不不不不。

lines.en: : Is there...
lines.zh: : 有没有……

lines.en: : Anything you want to me to {i}do{/i} to you?
lines.zh: : 什么你想让我对你{i}做{/i}的事？

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2

scene anotherfutabaevent18
Yes.
lines.zh: 有。

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了吗？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if what I just heard was actually real or not.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我刚才听到的到底是真的还是假的。

lines.en: : What did you hear, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你具体听到了什么？

lines.en: : Something that if I {i}didn’t{/i} hear and said out loud would cause a lot of problems for both of us.
lines.zh: : 一件如果我{i}没听清{/i}、却说出来，会给我们俩都惹来大麻烦的事。

lines.en: : Then...
: I guess you heard correctly.
lines.zh: : 我想你没听错。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent19
: U-Unless I...completely misunderstood something!
lines.zh: : 除、除非我……完全误会了什么！

lines.en: : Which, knowing me and my...no experience with boys...is extremely possible...
lines.zh: : 而以我对自己的了解，还有我……跟男孩子零经验这一点……这非常有可能……

lines.en: : If that’s the case...please forget that I said anything and...please forget how extremely inappropriate it would be for me to even {i}suggest{/i} that-
lines.zh: : 如果是那样的话……请当我什么都没说过，还有……请忘掉我居然会{i}提出{/i}那种极不得体的建议——

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent20
: Um...Y...Yeah?
lines.zh: : 呃……是、是吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent21
: I want to do everything I can to make you feel better, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我想尽我所能让你好受一点，Sensei……

lines.en: : And if you’re not the type who wants to talk about problems...
lines.zh: : 如果你是不喜欢把烦恼说出来的那种人……

lines.en: : Maybe I can...make you feel better in other ways?
lines.zh: : 也许我可以……用别的方式让你好受一点？

lines.en: : After all, it’s...it’s not like I haven’t been thinking about that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 毕竟……那种事我也不是没想过。

lines.en: : In fact...ever since you...admitted to being...a...aroused by me in my room...I’ve had trouble...{i}not{/i} thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 事实上……自从你……承认在我房间里……被我……唤起之后……我就很难……{i}不去{/i}想它。

lines.en: scene anotherfutabaevent22
: Would...something like that actually make you happy, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 那样的事……真的能让你开心吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: scene black
: Yes.
I lie as if it’s second nature, disguising my true feelings with yet another glance in the opposite direction.
lines.zh: 我撒谎撒得像出于本能，又一次把视线转向反方向，掩饰自己的真实感受。

lines.en: That must be the thousandth tonight.
lines.zh: 那大概是今晚的第一千次了。

lines.en: Futaba does not say anything after that. She simply nods- like she’s accepting a task as standard as cleaning the chalkboard or taking out the trash.
lines.zh: 在那之后 Futaba 什么也没说。她只是点了点头——就像接下一件和擦黑板、倒垃圾一样普通的差事。

lines.en: She books us a ride back to the dorm on her phone, using money her parents sent her so she can perform a sexual favor for her teacher in the comfort of her own room.
lines.zh: 她用手机叫了一辆回宿舍的车，用的是父母寄给她的钱——好让她能在自己房间里舒舒服服地为她的老师提供一次性服务。

lines.en: I’m sure they would be proud.
lines.zh: 我相信他们会很骄傲的。

lines.en: The car arrives- it’s the first one I’ve seen tonight.
lines.zh: 车来了——这是我今晚见到的第一辆车。

lines.en: When the two of us get inside, I sit closer to her than I did on the bench.
lines.zh: 我们俩上车之后，我坐得比在长椅上时离她更近。

lines.en: I reach for her hand while she’s not looking and place it in my lap.
lines.zh: 我趁她没在看的时候抓住她的手，把它放在我的腿上。

lines.en: She jumps, but understands what I want.
lines.zh: 她吓了一跳，但明白我想要什么。

lines.en: What she doesn’t understand is that it won’t make me happy.
lines.zh: 她不明白的是，那并不会让我开心。

lines.en: It will just make me a little less numb.
lines.zh: 它只会让我稍微没那么麻木。
